plan.idea: 用 20% 的 Top3 选股收益代理损失和 20% 的 Top3 净收益早停，检验能否弥补纯 RankIC 早停专家的头部收益损失，同时保留截面排序能力。
plan.selection_rule: Compare official net_ann & net_sharpe on matched style dates versus pure RankIC, old Top5 ES and v5, report RankIC, paired seeds, actual prefix. Attribute main effect with two single-axis controls; no weight search. T/joint representative native evaluation, all twelve candidates reported.
